brief_summary: Three-row comparison of sculpted keycap profiles against thumb-cluster fit. Each row pairs the profile name with a stepped-height glyph (R1 through R4) showing relative sculpt aggressiveness, a row-to-row height delta description, and a verdict. MT3 Dasher renders as a gentle taper (Workable, warm-grey), Cherry/CYL Ramune as a steep, angular staircase (Riskier, amber splash — the row the article flags as highest-risk), and uniform profiles as a flat line (Safest, warm-grey).
